corridor_responsibilities.responsibility: No scheduled hostile spawn; no deployment assigned.
Steward, GALLUS² and Durin damage the patrol. Require confirmed death before Steward's frame-3420 withdrawal.
Fang damages the eastern restraint; Melantha clears the western restraint. Ordinary operators neither attack nor block the civilian.
Plume then Cardigan block upper central enemies. Lancet-2 then Hibiscus heal. Lava supplies permanent arts damage after deployment.
Noir Corne then Beagle block lower central enemies. Ansel heals after deployment; Durin and later Lava clear armor and congestion.
Fang handles the opening upper outer enemies; Melantha handles subsequent officers with western-facing attacks and later Hibiscus healing.
Friston-3 hands the opening raider to Midnight. Midnight retains two-block interception and receives Ansel's healing before the later officer pairs.
Durin clears the eastern restraint and Midnight clears the western restraint. Both must release the civilian before officers can exploit its stationary position.

deployment_positions_and_directions.role: Opening upper central interception; hand off to Cardigan.
Economical opening lower central three-block holder.
Opening upper outer interception, eastern roadblock damage and two conditional DP grants.
Delay the first lower outer raider until Midnight can take the same tile.
Opening global heal and upper-lane healing.
Permanent lower outer interception and western roadblock clearance.
Principal damage across the patrol's eastern vertical circuit.
Supplementary patrol damage using ordinary arts attacks.
Lower eastern roadblock clearance, supplementary patrol damage and permanent lower central arts damage.
Upper western roadblock clearance and permanent upper outer duels.
Heal the lower central holder, Midnight and Durin.
Replace Noir Corne with a durable lower central three-block holder.
Heal the upper central holder, Melantha and Lava.
Permanent arts damage covering both central blocking tiles; no splash credit.
Replace Plume with upper central three-block capacity; no self-heal credit.

formation_structure.exposure: Physicians at column 3 are separated from the central holders at column 5. This changes exposure geometry but does not establish immunity or artillery target selection.
formation_structure.final: Cardigan and Beagle hold the central lanes; Melantha and Midnight hold the outer lanes. Hibiscus and Ansel heal their respective formations. Lava and Durin supply permanent armor damage.
formation_structure.opening: Plume and Noir Corne catch central raiders. Fang catches upper outer enemies. Friston-3 delays the lower outer raider until Midnight replaces him. Lancet-2 supplies the first healing bridge.
formation_structure.patrol_battery: Steward covers the full eastern vertical circuit. GALLUS² covers its lower section. Durin covers its upper section while also reaching the lower eastern roadblock. Their attacks have no assumed target priority.

formation_transitions.transition: Retreat Friston-3 and immediately deploy Midnight on [6,3].
Durin completes the patrol battery and assumes lower eastern clearance.
Retreat Fang after the second expected DP grant; retain no later Fang income.
Melantha establishes upper western clearance before the next upper outer officer wave.
Replace GALLUS² with Ansel; Steward and Durin must finish any remaining patrol HP.
Release Steward only after confirmed patrol death; an unmet death requirement invalidates this fixed candidate.
Replace Noir Corne directly with Beagle.
Replace Lancet-2 with Hibiscus at the western upper healing position.
Lava occupies Lancet-2's vacated tile and establishes permanent central arts coverage.
Replace Plume directly with Cardigan before the paired central raiders.

mandatory_tactical_invariants.requirement: Every selected operator belongs to normal_low_star_catalog, has identity.rarity from 1 through 3, and qualification.normal_mode true; exclude reserve variants.
DEPLOY tiles are integer [row,col] pairs on legal terrain. Never deploy on [[1,2],[6,2],[1,6],[6,6]].
At most eight operators are deployed; listed same-frame retreats precede replacement deployments.
Fund purchases using initial DP, natural recovery and only Fang's two surviving automatic grants. Count no refunds or unsupported income.
Friston-3 must remain alive until frame 1305 and Midnight must intercept the released raider without a leak.
Noir Corne, required opening holders and the patrol battery must survive their assigned windows. No unobserved artillery targeting preference is assumed; lethal exposure falsifies this candidate.
The patrol must be dead before frame 3420. Do not withdraw a still-required patrol attacker and claim successful conversion.
Destroy both restraints on each civilian route before restraint-associated officer pressure becomes lethal. Clearance timing is an unverified requirement, not a supplied result.
Ordinary operators neither attack nor block civilians. Do not assign civilian healing or guaranteed officer target selection.
Both central three-block holders must be established before the final paired central raiders accumulate.
Count no dodge, critical talent, resistance debuff, Friston damage reduction, Cardigan self-heal or unspecified splash geometry.
WIN requires remaining_life > 0, zero leaks, exhausted spawns and no active enemies. Retain the final formation until all conditions hold.

pressure_window_responsibilities.responsibility: Establish all four interception duties; deploy Lancet-2 after the opening central holders have taken damage.
Complete the lower outer handoff, preserve both Fang income grants, and establish the patrol battery.
Melantha clears the upper western restraint; Durin clears the lower eastern restraint; the battery must kill the patrol while all required interceptors survive.
Finish physician deployment and the Beagle handoff. Maintain outer interceptions and hold the first central armor.
Lava adds central arts damage. Cardigan supplies three-block capacity before paired upper raiders; Beagle retains lower capacity.
Maintain all final holders, physicians and arts attackers until the spawn schedule is exhausted, every hostile is cleared, zero leaks are recorded and remaining life is positive.

skill_intents.intent: Automatic grants near 43 and 68 seconds require survival from deployment at 24 seconds. The budget includes exactly these two grants.
Accelerate the opening officer kill and contribute damage during the first armor window.
Use the first arts window for western clearance and initial later officers; use the second for final outer pressure.
Shorten officer duels when ready; no unsupported talent bonus is included.
Increase lower healing during successive pressure windows. Baseline range already covers all assigned lower allies.
Reduce physical damage during central armor and congestion.
Increase upper healing during central armor and subsequent clearance.
Activate after the evidenced ten-second preparation, then respect active-duration SP pauses.
Use automatic attack-SP enhanced hits without assuming highest-defense targeting.
No self-healing skill responsibility; ordinary physician healing is required.

revised_operational_plans.tactical_thesis: Use cheaper opening interception to establish an earlier three-caster patrol battery, clear both civilian corridors with operators that have actual reach, then convert released slots and DP into durable central blocking, physicians and permanent arts damage. This is an untested candidate: survival during the patrol battery window remains a critical unresolved dependency.

unknown_dependencies.consequence: The delayed physicians do not establish survival of Noir Corne or fragile casters. Repeated lethal targeting rejects the candidate.
Actual destruction times and patrol attack uptime cannot be certified from the pasted evidence.
unknown_dependencies.dependency: Roadblock durability and competing ordinary targets

unknown_dependencies.consequence: The planned conversion fails if the patrol remains active.

revised_stage_understanding.causal_revision: M25's late physician deaths and subsequent formation collapse require a different opening, earlier patrol damage and explicit replacement responsibilities. Its reported final DP does not establish that earlier conditional purchases were available.
revised_stage_understanding.current_model_rules: Use the supplied quantized spawn schedule, neutral civilian rules, special roadblock restraint, officer attack radius and positive-life WIN requirement.
revised_stage_understanding.gamedata_facts: The supplied terrain, operator statistics, ranges, source routes and skill parameters define legal placements and intended coverage.
revised_stage_understanding.inspection_limit: Read-only shell execution failed before running because the sandbox app-server socket directory had invalid ownership or permissions. The saved M26 V1 action list could not be retrieved; exact tactical preservation cannot be asserted.
revised_stage_understanding.m26_v1_status: CONTRACT_INVALID with NO_SIMULATION; its hypothesis-reference error is not tactical failure evidence.
revised_stage_understanding.validation_status: UNTESTED_CANDIDATE; no stage simulation or file modification performed.

revised_strategic_hypotheses.falsifier: An opening holder dies, the lower outer handoff leaks, or either Fang grant is absent.
revised_strategic_hypotheses.tactical_hypothesis: Plume and Noir Corne can hold the central opening while Fang and Friston-3 establish the outer interceptions, allowing a same-tile Midnight handoff and two surviving Fang grants.

revised_strategic_hypotheses.falsifier: Artillery exposure, competing targets or insufficient attack uptime leave the patrol alive at the conversion.
revised_strategic_hypotheses.tactical_hypothesis: Earlier overlapping eastern coverage from Steward, GALLUS² and Durin can kill the patrol before frame 3420.

revised_strategic_hypotheses.falsifier: A restraint persists into lethal officer contact or a civilian dies.
revised_strategic_hypotheses.tactical_hypothesis: Fang and Durin can clear the eastern restraints while Melantha and Midnight clear the western restraints, allowing civilian movement before officers exploit restraint.

revised_strategic_hypotheses.falsifier: Central occupancy exceeds capacity, healing fails, or any hostile leaks.
revised_strategic_hypotheses.tactical_hypothesis: The final eight-operator formation can retain three-block central capacity while Lava and Durin clear armor and the outer duelists prevent bypasses.

revised_tactical_requirements.clearance: Maintain two physicians, two central three-block holders, both outer interceptors and permanent arts damage through final clearance.
revised_tactical_requirements.contract: Exactly one plan; parent_hypothesis_id references a declared strategic hypothesis; every deployment has legal coordinates and direction; timeline frames are nondecreasing.
revised_tactical_requirements.opening: Catch all four hostile corridors before their first enemies pass the legal interception tiles; preserve the Friston-to-Midnight handoff and both budgeted Fang grants.
revised_tactical_requirements.patrol: Obtain sufficient real attack uptime and nonlethal exposure for the eastern battery; require observed death before conversion.
revised_tactical_requirements.protection: Release both civilians through actual roadblock destruction and maintain officer interceptions without assuming officers prefer operators.
revised_tactical_requirements.verification_boundary: Do not claim complete client navigation proof or a demonstrated win. Critical survival and clearance dependencies remain falsifiable.

changed_responsibilities: Plume takes upper central opening combat while Noir Corne supplies economical lower central blocking.
Friston-3 delays the lower outer raider until Midnight replaces him on the same tile.
Fang supplies only two conditional grants and hands upper outer responsibility to Melantha.
Steward, GALLUS² and Durin receive earlier patrol coverage duties with a required death check before conversion.
Physicians move to column 3 with verified intended healing reach; no artillery immunity is assumed.
Cardigan and Beagle supply final central capacity while Lava and Durin retain permanent armor damage.
revision_hypothesis.if_expected_event_absent: Reject the opening interception hypothesis and inspect deployment availability, actual contact geometry and holder survival. Do not attribute the failure to DP arithmetic or continue counting unsupported downstream income.
revision_hypothesis.tactical_hypothesis: Repair the invalid parent reference independently of tactical evaluation. The reconstructed candidate addresses M25's demonstrated interception and survival failures with cheaper opening roles, earlier patrol coverage, reachable roadblock assignments and explicit durable handoffs; its artillery survival remains unverified.
